items.headline: Bitcoin rebounds 9% from two-year low back above $60,000
items.summary: Bitcoin climbed about 9% off a two-year low to reclaim the $60,000 level, as traders look ahead to Monday's stock market open. A sell-off had erased $1.8 billion in leveraged crypto positions, mostly long bets on rising prices.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin bounces 9% from two-year low to retake $60,000 as traders eye Monday’s stock open

items.headline: Singapore plans sandbox for AI agents making stablecoin payments
items.summary: A planned sandbox would examine how banks and payment providers confirm an AI agent's authority before it carries out stablecoin payments. The excerpt gives few further details.
items.sourceTitle: Singapore wants to test stablecoin payments by AI agents

items.headline: SEC Says Fake Crypto Exchanges Defrauded US Investors of $37M
items.summary: The SEC alleges eight Colorado-registered entities, likely operated from overseas, impersonated legitimate advisers and crypto platforms, including faking SEC certificates and filings. The scheme reportedly defrauded U.S. investors of more than $37 million.
items.sourceTitle: Fraudsters Used Fake Crypto Exchanges to Steal $37 Million, SEC Alleges

items.headline: Bitwise CIO Says Washington Politics Are Hurting Crypto Growth
items.summary: Bitwise CIO Matt Hougan argues that regulatory constraints are preventing crypto from delivering on its promise to upgrade the financial system. He says current rules block changes needed for innovation.
items.sourceTitle: Washington Politics Are Crushing Crypto Industry Ambitions, Warns Bitwise CIO

items.headline: Coins.ph restricts transfers to self-custody wallets
items.summary: The Philippine exchange now allows external crypto transfers only to regulated exchanges and requires counterparty details for every amount. The change limits withdrawals to self-custody wallets.
items.sourceTitle: Coins.ph Halts Transfers With Self-Custody Wallets

items.headline: Bitcoin dips under $60,000 as crypto liquidations hit $1.57B
items.summary: Bitcoin fell below $60,000, and crypto liquidations totaled $1.57 billion over 24 hours. The excerpt offers no further detail on the cause.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Falls Below $60,000 as Crypto Liquidations Reach $1.57 Billion in 24 Hours - Hokanews

items.headline: Bitquery Tracks Over $1.58M Stolen in Fluidkey Exploit
items.summary: Fluidkey says a flaw in a logging tool let an attacker trigger transfers when users opened the app. Private keys remained on users' devices.
items.sourceTitle: Bitquery Traces at Least $1.58 Million in Fluidkey Hack

items.headline: Aave V4 proposal would route idle USDC into Circle Gateway
items.summary: A proposed Aave V4 plan would let idle USDC be swept into Circle Gateway, with exposure capped at 10 million USDC and 25% of supply. Cash would still be kept available for withdrawals and loans.
items.sourceTitle: Aave V4 Plan Would Put Idle USDC Into Circle Gateway

items.headline: BENQI Proposes Queue to Cut sAVAX Unstaking Delays
items.summary: BENQI plans a new queue system to shorten waits for sAVAX unstaking. Pending requests will carry over with their elapsed time preserved, and existing holders won't need to move or swap tokens.
items.sourceTitle: BENQI Plans New Queue to Shorten sAVAX Unstaking Waits

items.headline: Sky disputes illicit fund claims amid $2B stablecoin outflows
items.summary: Sky says its USDS stablecoin kept its $1 peg despite over $2 billion in withdrawals. The protocol is also contesting a report that links it to illicit activity.
items.sourceTitle: Sky Protocol sees $2 billion in stablecoin withdrawals, disputes illicit fund claims

items.headline: JPMorgan says bitcoin's drop widens gap to production cost
items.summary: JPMorgan estimates bitcoin's production cost at $86,000, and a recent price decline has increased the distance between that figure and the market price. The excerpt gives no further detail.
items.sourceTitle: JPMorgan says bitcoin price correction widens gap to estimated $86,000 production cost

items.headline: Bitcoin falls under $59,000 as crypto liquidations exceed $1.5 billion
items.summary: Bitcoin dropped below $59,000 on Friday, touching a multi-month low of $58,701. The decline extends a sharp November sell-off and leaves the asset down more than 30% for the year so far.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Price Crashes Below $59K as Crypto Liquidations Top $1.5B

items.headline: Bitcoin dips under $60,000 in live market update
items.summary: Bitcoin's price has fallen below $60,000, according to a live market report. The excerpt provides no further details on the cause or scope of the decline.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin crash live: price below $60,000 - CryptoTicker.io

items.headline: Bitcoin falls to four-month low as tech stocks weaken
items.summary: Bitcoin remains under pressure following Anthropic's IPO, while Nasdaq futures have slipped below their 200-day average.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin hits four-month low after Anthropic's IPO as tech stocks wilt

items.headline: Bitcoin Drops to Mining Cost as Hashrate Nears Peak
items.summary: Bitcoin has reached roughly $62,000, a level tied to mining costs, while network hashrate approaches a record. On-chain data is cited as still pointing to further downside.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Falls to Mining Cost Level as Hashrate Nears Record and Indicators Flip Bearish

items.headline: Optimism's OP token falls 25% weekly, lagging Bitcoin
items.summary: The Optimism governance token has dropped about 39% over 28 days, erasing its October gains. Ether declined less steeply across both time windows.
items.sourceTitle: Optimism’s OP Drops 25% in a Week, Trailing Bitcoin

items.headline: Bitcoin hits new selloff low at $61,220 on Coinbase
items.summary: Bitcoin fell to a fresh low of $61,220 on Coinbase, with its losses over roughly four weeks reaching 24.6% according to CoinGecko. Most tokens on a watchlist also declined over the past day.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Sets New Selloff Low of $61,220 on Coinbase

items.headline: Coinbase reportedly plans its own US prediction markets
items.summary: Bloomberg reports that Coinbase is planning in-house prediction market contracts in the US, which currently rely on Kalshi. The offering would target retail and institutional customers, with a launch aimed at the first half of 2027.
items.sourceTitle: Coinbase Plans In-House US Prediction Markets: Bloomberg

items.headline: Bitcoin forms death cross as Anthropic IPO fails to lift stocks
items.summary: Bitcoin slipped after Anthropic's shares jumped on their Nasdaq debut while broader stocks fell. Bitcoin's daily chart shows deeply oversold momentum and a strong downtrend.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Enters Death Cross as Anthropic IPO Fails to Lift Wall Street

items.headline: Sky lifts stUSDS yield; app shows zero withdrawal liquidity
items.summary: Sky raised the stUSDS yield to 24.74%, and a later app snapshot showed no withdrawal liquidity. A borrower's repayment and a bot's redemption came just before the rate change.
items.sourceTitle: Sky Raises stUSDS Yield to 24.74%; App Shows $0 Liquidity

items.headline: Higher rates may curb Bitcoin buying by treasury firms
items.summary: Treasury companies holding Bitcoin could find it harder to issue new shares on terms that justify further purchases, even when dividends are well covered. The excerpt suggests rising interest rates as the pressure point.
items.sourceTitle: Why higher rates could slow Bitcoin buying at treasury firms

items.headline: Kraken parent Payward agrees to buy Tribe Capital
items.summary: Payward, the parent company of Kraken, is acquiring Tribe Capital to broaden its private-market offerings. The move adds private-market sourcing, underwriting and fund management capabilities to Payward's platform.
items.sourceTitle: Kraken parent Payward to acquire Tribe Capital to expand private-market offerings

items.headline: Bitcoin Testnet5 launches so miners can trial four proposed fixes
items.summary: A new Bitcoin test network lets mining pools check the blocks their software builds while Bitcoin Core and Sparrow Wallet prepare support.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin launches Testnet5 and gives miners a real trial of four proposed fixes

items.headline: Three firms finish trial of tokenized deposit interoperability
items.summary: Standard Chartered, StraitsX and OCBC have completed a trial focused on interoperability for tokenized deposits. The companies argue that cross-platform compatibility is needed for such deposits to reach their full potential.
items.sourceTitle: Standard Chartered, StraitsX, OCBC complete trial of tokenized deposit interoperability

items.headline: Ondo Finance Joins MAS Project Guardian on Asset Tokenisation
items.summary: Ondo Finance has joined Singapore's Monetary Authority of Singapore initiative Project Guardian, which focuses on developing tokenised assets in financial markets. The firm will contribute its experience bringing tokenised assets to investors.
items.sourceTitle: Ondo Finance Joins MAS’ Project Guardian to Support Asset Tokenisation

items.headline: CoinGecko gains Solana Foundation support, explores adding crypto trading
items.summary: Data platform CoinGecko has received backing from the Solana Foundation and is looking at trading features. Details on how and when such trading would launch have not been provided.
items.sourceTitle: CoinGecko secures Solana Foundation backing and eyes crypto trading

items.headline: Coinbase AI system stops $4.7M in deepfake Musk scam transfers
items.summary: Coinbase says its AI defense system stopped about 91% of attempted transfers tied to a fake Tesla livestream, with no human involvement.
items.sourceTitle: Coinbase AI defense blocks $4.7 million from being sent to deepfake Elon Musk scam

items.headline: Crypto startup valuations diverge as top firms hit new highs
items.summary: Crypto unicorns from the 2021 boom now trade at steep secondary-market discounts of 50% to 70%. Meanwhile, the leading companies have reached new valuation highs.
items.sourceTitle: What’s happening to crypto startup valuations?

items.headline: DBS and Circle add round-the-clock USDC access for institutions
items.summary: Eligible institutional clients can now mint and redeem USDC through DBS, giving them a bank-based route to dollar stablecoin liquidity in Asia.
items.sourceTitle: DBS, Circle Add 24/7 Institutional USDC Access in Asia

items.headline: Fed's Waller Expects Stablecoins and Tokenized Deposits to Coexist
items.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller expects stablecoins, tokenized bank deposits and other digital payment instruments to operate side by side as blockchain becomes more integrated into traditional finance. He said the payments future will likely include several forms of tokenized money alongside existing banking infrastructure.
items.sourceTitle: Fed Governor Sees Stablecoins, Tokenized Deposits Coexisting in Financial System

items.headline: Ethereum developers debate scaling upgrade that may disrupt apps
items.summary: Developers warned on a core dev call that two scaling changes in the Glamsterdam upgrade break assumptions some contracts rely on. The changes would boost capacity but could affect many applications.
items.sourceTitle: Ethereum Devs Weigh a Scaling Upgrade That Could Break 15,000 Apps

items.headline: Western Union Reports Its Solana Cash-Out Network Is Live
items.summary: Solana points to access to 400,000 cash-pickup locations, though Western Union's consumer site still labels global cash-out as coming soon.
items.sourceTitle: Western Union Says Solana Cash-Out Network Is Live

items.headline: US Bitcoin ETF Outflows Snap as Investors Return
items.summary: US Bitcoin ETFs ended a streak of outflows totaling $1.91 billion, while Bitcoin held around the $62,000 level. The report also notes which funds are seeing inflows.
items.sourceTitle: Wall Street Investors Slowly Get Back to Bitcoin After a $1.9 Billion Exit

items.headline: Coinbase extends onchain crypto loans to New York users
items.summary: Coinbase has widened its onchain crypto lending product to residents of New York. Bitcoin, Ether and Solana are accepted as collateral.
items.sourceTitle: Coinbase expands onchain crypto loans to New York via Morpho

items.headline: Bitcoin whales hold record unrealized losses without selling
items.summary: Short-term Bitcoin whales are sitting on nearly $8 billion in unrealized losses, a record high, after a roughly 30% drop since October. Exchange inflows remain fairly contained, suggesting recent large buyers have not rushed to sell.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Whales Sit on Record $8 Billion Losses—but They Aren’t Selling

items.headline: Democrat senators flag illicit finance gaps in SEC tokenized stock plan
items.summary: Four Democratic senators have raised concerns about the SEC's newly unveiled innovation exemption. The excerpt is brief, so details of their specific objections are not covered here.
items.sourceTitle: Democratic senators warn SEC’s tokenized stock exemption has illicit finance gaps

items.headline: Tom Lee Links Ether Slump to Nvidia and Anthropic IPO
items.summary: Bitmine's holdings dropped to $11.8 billion from $14.3 billion a week earlier as ether fell 28% over two weeks. Chairman Tom Lee attributes the sharp decline to Nvidia fallout and cash raising ahead of Anthropic's IPO.
items.sourceTitle: Tom Lee Blames Nvidia and Anthropic IPO for Ethereum Plunge as Bitmine Buys the Dip

items.headline: US Bitcoin ETFs See $1.07B Weekly Outflow, Third Straight Loss
items.summary: U.S. bitcoin ETFs posted $1.07 billion in net outflows for the week through November 13, their third consecutive weekly decline. Two-week outflows now total $2.35 billion.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin ETFs Lose $1.07B in a Week, Pushing 2-Week Outflows to $2.35B

items.headline: Proposed XRP upgrade may aid trading, but not necessarily token demand
items.summary: A proposed upgrade to XRP would introduce new pool-pricing curves that could improve trade execution. Any added demand for holding the token would depend on adoption, routing and sustained funding.
items.sourceTitle: XRP’s proposed upgrade could improve trading without boosting token demand

items.headline: Coinbase and Broadridge float standard for tokenized stock disclosures
items.summary: Coinbase and Broadridge have proposed a standard that would link holders of tokenized stocks with corporate disclosures and voting materials in digital wallets. The standard would not itself grant shareholder rights.
items.sourceTitle: Coinbase and Broadridge propose standard for tokenized stock disclosures

items.headline: Binance Founder CZ Suggests Reasons Behind Recent Crypto Price Drop
items.summary: Changpeng Zhao listed possible pressures on crypto prices, including IPO demand, fund withdrawals, security concerns, inflation and politics. He said their link to the selloff was unclear and mentioned recent personal purchases.
items.sourceTitle: Why Are Crypto Prices Down? Binance Founder CZ Lists Possible Reasons

items.headline: Ripple co-founder Schwartz reveals sharp cut in XRP holdings
items.summary: David Schwartz says he has significantly reduced his XRP, bitcoin and ether holdings, citing discomfort with investment risk. He still argues XRP would likely benefit if the XRP Ledger succeeds.
items.sourceTitle: Ripple’s David Schwartz Once Held 26 Million XRP. Now Just 3 Million

items.headline: Saylor Points to Four Bitcoin Metrics Amid Price Drop
items.summary: Michael Saylor highlighted four Bitcoin metrics to frame the recent price decline. Binance co-founder CZ responded that correlation does not equal causation.
items.sourceTitle: Saylor Highlights 4 Rare and Extreme Metrics Bitcoin Has Just Hit to Explain Price

items.headline: Crypto Selloff Deepens as XRP Falls to Two-Year Low
items.summary: Crypto markets lost over $130 billion since Friday as XRP dropped below $1 and bitcoin dipped to an intraday low of $61,947. Sentiment has reached extreme fear, and $1.71 billion in leveraged positions were liquidated overnight.
items.sourceTitle: Crypto Market Rout Deepens as XRP Price Hits 2-Year Low and ETF Money Flees

items.headline: Bitcoin slides under $67,000 as $1.6B in liquidations deepen fear
items.summary: Bitcoin fell below $67,000 amid a $1.6 billion wave of liquidations, with market sentiment described as extreme fear.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Drops Below $67,000 as $1.6B Liquidation Wave Deepens ‘Extreme Fear’ - NFTevening

items.headline: Saylor Teases Another Strategy Bitcoin Purchase as Prices Fall
items.summary: Michael Saylor hinted at another bitcoin buy by Strategy during a sharp market drop. The company's holdings remain below acquisition cost.
items.sourceTitle: Michael Saylor Hints at Another Strategy Bitcoin Buy as BTC Slides

items.headline: Wall Street Firms Race to Dominate Onchain Dollar Market
items.summary: Major traditional finance players, including Goldman, Citi, SoFi, Anchorage, Mastercard, Visa and Circle, are moving into onchain dollar products. The excerpt notes the space was previously led by Tether and Circle.
items.sourceTitle: How Wall Street Is Racing to Claim the Onchain Dollar

items.headline: Binance's Ether Reserves Fall to Lowest Since 2021
items.summary: Binance's ETH holdings dropped to roughly 2.9 million, their smallest level in almost five years, even as Ether's price slid to its lowest point since early July. Coins leaving exchanges are often read as a sign holders are not selling.
items.sourceTitle: Binance Holds the Least Ethereum Since 2021

items.headline: Large ETH Holders Buy as Price Dips Below $1,800
items.summary: Onchain swap data shows some large wallets buying ether during the decline. Analytics firm Lookonchain's exchange withdrawal tally, however, does not confirm new purchases.
items.sourceTitle: Large Wallets Buy ETH as Price Falls Below $1,800

items.headline: Bitcoin appears undervalued on one metric after ETF outflows
items.summary: An adjusted MVRV signal from analyst Darkfost suggests Bitcoin's valuation has become lower, while ETF withdrawals and an SOPR reading leave any recovery unconfirmed.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin now looks cheap by one measure after $1 billion in ETF outflows

items.headline: Glassnode Flags Large Bitcoin Leveraged Liquidation Zone Near $60K
items.summary: Glassnode warned that a concentration of leveraged positions near $60,000 could fuel forced selling and deepen Bitcoin's decline. The firm pointed to thinner trading liquidity and losses on bullish bets adding pressure across crypto markets.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Faces Massive Liquidation Cluster Near $60K, Glassnode Warns

items.headline: Kraken Parent Posts Quarterly Profit Rebound Ahead of IPO
items.summary: Payward, the parent of crypto exchange Kraken, reported adjusted third-quarter earnings of $60 million, up from $23 million in the second quarter. The figure was still 67% lower than a year earlier, according to a shareholder letter cited by Bloomberg.
items.sourceTitle: Kraken Parent’s Profit Rebound Still Leaves a Wide Gap Before Its IPO

items.headline: Kazakhstan to issue tokenized government bonds next quarter
items.summary: Kazakhstan plans to launch tokenized government bonds in the first quarter, following its first sale of tokenized central bank notes. The move comes as the country expands its crypto market.
items.sourceTitle: Kazakhstan plans tokenized government bonds in first quarter after $22 million note sale

items.headline: UK, Singapore and Thailand central banks test cross-border FX settlement
items.summary: A project called Meridian FX APAC showed how transactions can be coordinated between traditional settlement systems and blockchain-based ones. The test involves central banks from the UK, Singapore and Thailand.
items.sourceTitle: UK, Singapore, and Thailand central banks test cross-border FX settlement as stablecoins gain ground

items.headline: HYPE Token Holds Up Better Than Bitcoin and Ether in Selloff
items.summary: Hyperliquid's HYPE token has fallen about a quarter from its peak but is outperforming Bitcoin and Ethereum during the latest market downturn. Its derivatives market is cited as one possible reason, with HYPE near $73 on Friday.
items.sourceTitle: Hyperliquid's HYPE Token Shows Resilience as Crypto Market Crash Deepens

items.headline: Market makers may be amplifying bitcoin and ether price swings
items.summary: Bitcoin and ether are trading in ranges where market makers and dealers could be adding to volatility. The excerpt is brief and offers no further detail.
items.sourceTitle: A behind the scenes force may amplify bitcoin and ether price volatility

items.headline: AAVE Drops 30% Over Four Weeks, Worse Than BTC and ETH
items.summary: The Aave governance token fell further than bitcoin and ether over the period, while the dollar value of assets locked on Aave declined by a smaller percentage.
items.sourceTitle: AAVE Slides 30% in Four Weeks, Trailing Bitcoin and Ether

items.headline: Unocoin pauses all services after hackers get around BitGo freeze
items.summary: Indian exchange Unocoin says disputed transfers were signed outside BitGo while it investigates suspected misuse of a backup mechanism. The firm has halted all services during the probe.
items.sourceTitle: Unocoin halts all services after hackers bypass BitGo freeze

items.headline: Glassnode Data Flags Quantum Risk for Over a Third of Bitcoin
items.summary: Analytics firm Glassnode counted about 7.12 million bitcoin whose public keys already appear on the public ledger, a potential quantum vulnerability. Most owners could fix it quickly, but some early coins may never be secured.
items.sourceTitle: Over 35% of Bitcoin Supply Faces Potential Quantum Risk, New Data Shows

items.headline: Grayscale Says Crypto Offers Opportunities Beyond Bitcoin
items.summary: Grayscale said crypto's growth is opening investment options beyond bitcoin, as sectors differ in business models, adoption and token economics. Its analysis links weakening correlations to a greater role for picking individual assets, while noting marketwide risks remain.
items.sourceTitle: Grayscale Sees New Crypto Opportunities as Bitcoin’s Grip Weakens

items.headline: BitGo rejects breach claims as Unocoin investigates transfers
items.summary: BitGo says the disputed transfers were made with keys held by Unocoin and without its involvement. Unocoin suspects a backup mechanism was misused, and its services remain suspended.
items.sourceTitle: BitGo Denies Breach as Unocoin Probes Wallet Transfers

items.headline: Trump Names First Democrats for SEC and CFTC Posts
items.summary: Trump has proposed a bipartisan slate of two Republicans and two Democrats for the SEC and CFTC, his first Democratic picks for either agency. The nominees would fill commissions that shape crypto policy.
items.sourceTitle: Trump’s First Democratic Picks for SEC and CFTC Could Reshape Crypto’s Regulators

items.headline: Bitcoin slides to 12-week low as rate-hike worries erase rally
items.summary: Bitcoin has fallen back to around August price levels as stubborn inflation, rising expectations of another rate increase and ETF outflows weigh on the market.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Hits 12-Week Low as Fed Rate Fears Undo Most of Summer Rally

items.headline: About $600M in Long Positions Liquidated as Bitcoin, Ether Drop
items.summary: Traders betting on higher prices lost $599 million in 24 hours as Bitcoin and Ethereum fell to their lowest levels in nearly three months. Longs accounted for 88% of $680.81 million in total crypto liquidations.
items.sourceTitle: Nearly $600 Million in Crypto Longs Liquidated as Bitcoin and Ethereum Fall to August Lows

items.headline: Bitcoin Falls to Around $70,600 Amid Extended Losses
items.summary: Bitcoin slid to about $70,600 as its four-week decline deepened. Coinbase also hit a fresh 28-day low, and ether kept trailing bitcoin over one- and four-week periods.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Sinks to $70,600 as Four-Week Losses Deepen

items.headline: Visa to Settle Stablecoin Transactions Using Western Union's USDPT
items.summary: Anchorage Digital is working with Visa so that certain stablecoins issued by its federally regulated bank, beginning with Western Union's USDPT, can serve as settlement assets on Visanet.
items.sourceTitle: Visa Adds Western Union’s USDPT for Stablecoin Settlement via Anchorage

items.headline: Aave user loses $305,000 in Across Protocol website hijack
items.summary: A user reportedly lost about $305,000 from an Aave deposit token after the Across Protocol website was hijacked. Blockchain analytics firm Bitquery estimates total losses of roughly $401,900 across nine wallets.
items.sourceTitle: Aave user loses $305,000 after Across Protocol website hijack

items.headline: Binance says hacked assets are covered; proof pending
items.summary: Binance says it has closed the remaining gap in customer backing. Users will need to wait for cryptographic proof of a new snapshot before they can verify it.
items.sourceTitle: Binance Says Hack Assets Covered, Reserve Proof Pending

items.headline: Sky advisor suggests pausing new borrowing from core vaults
items.summary: BA Labs, a Sky advisor, has proposed stopping new borrowing from core vaults, which would leave existing borrowers able to repay and manage collateral but not mint more. The report cites 771 open vaults holding about 376.33 million USDS in debt.
items.sourceTitle: Sky Advisor Proposes Halting New Core Vault Borrowing

items.headline: New York regulator sets 2027 deadline for crypto marketing rules
items.summary: New York's financial regulator will require BitLicense holders and crypto trust companies to prepare annually approved marketing policies. The policies are to cover risk disclosures, paid promoters and misleading claims, with a May 2027 deadline.
items.sourceTitle: NYDFS Sets May 2027 Deadline for Crypto Ad Policies

items.headline: New York regulator issues crypto advertising guidance for firms
items.summary: The New York Department of Financial Services has released guidance setting out what it expects crypto firms to do when creating policies and procedures for advertising and marketing.
items.sourceTitle: NYDFS sets fresh advertising standards for crypto firms

items.headline: DOJ, Banks and DeFi Groups Back Suit Against Illinois Crypto Tax
items.summary: The Justice Department, the U.S. Chamber of Commerce, SIFMA and a crypto coalition including a16z, Paradigm and Uniswap have filed briefs supporting a lawsuit seeking to invalidate Illinois' 0.2% tax on digital asset transactions.
items.sourceTitle: Illinois Crypto Tax Draws Unlikely Alliance of DOJ, Banks and DeFi

items.headline: Crypto industry says Illinois crypto tax can't be enforced as written
items.summary: Crypto industry groups have filed opposition in a court challenge to a crypto transaction tax in Illinois, arguing the tax would not work in practice.
items.sourceTitle: Illinois crypto tax is impossible to enforce as written, crypto industry tells court

items.headline: Bitcoin dominance tests 61% level; altcoin impact discussed
items.summary: Bitcoin's market dominance is testing a 61% breakout level, and a weekly Supertrend indicator has flipped bullish. The piece looks at what this could mean for altcoins.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Dominance Tests 61% Breakout, and That's Bad News for Altcoins

items.headline: Solana Company posts Q3 revenue rise on staking rewards
items.summary: Solana Company, a digital asset treasury firm, reported quarterly revenue of $3.4 million, up from $697,000 a year earlier. The company's growth was linked to staking rewards.
items.sourceTitle: ‘Milestone quarter’: Solana Company reports Q3 revenue growth driven by staking rewards

items.headline: Large Bitcoin holders accumulate as ETF investors pull out funds
items.summary: Glassnode data through November 9 shows a narrow pattern of whale accumulation, while Bitcoin ETF sessions through November 10 still recorded outflows.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin whales stack coins while ETF investors dump millions daily

items.headline: Zcash Slides Under $965 After 26% Weekly Drop
items.summary: Zcash's seven-day decline was about three times larger than bitcoin's. The token now trades roughly 43% below its late-September level.
items.sourceTitle: Zcash Falls Below $965 as Weekly Loss Reaches 26%

items.headline: Bitcoin Heads for First Back-to-Back Annual Losses
items.summary: Bitcoin is on track for two consecutive years of losses, which would break a long-running pattern of annual gains. The excerpt notes that the data contains some nuance.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Faces First Back-to-Back Annual Losses in History, But There's a Catch

items.headline: Bitcoin Recovers Above $74,000 Following Inflation-Driven Dip
items.summary: Bitcoin climbed back above $74,600 after falling to $72,787 when U.S. inflation data came in hotter than expected. Market-wide liquidations totaled $199 million, with $51 million tied to bitcoin.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Price Reclaims $74K After CPI Sell-Off Sparks Volatility

items.headline: Stablecoin supply shrinks by $14.2 billion, largest drop since 2022
items.summary: Total stablecoin supply fell by $14.2 billion, the steepest contraction since the 2022 downturn. USDT and USDC together dropped by nearly $11 billion over the past month, while gold-backed tokens stayed flat.
items.sourceTitle: Stablecoin supply drops $14.2 billion in largest contraction since 2022 bear market
